integrity: The arbitrary-size result is supported by a direct structural proof. Exhaustive game search over 1168 signings on six small biclique profiles and 651 additional deterministic profiles is corroborative only and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific limitations: The theorem is restricted to signed complete bipartite graphs with both shores of size at least two. The initiating paper is extremely recent, and its full text was not available through the lawful open-access routes checked during this review, leaving a residual risk that an equivalent biclique observation appears in material not exposed by the public abstract or current indexes.
title: Exact plurality number of signed complete bipartite graphs from sign correlations
